title: Gūthakhādi -- Duṭṭhabrāhmaṇo
text: 1 Idhāham āvuso Gijjhakūṭā pabbatā orohanto addasaṃ purisaṃ gūthakūpe nimuggaṃ ubhohi hatthehi gūtham khādantaṃ || || 2 Eso bhikkhave satto imasmiññeva Rājagahe brāhmaṇo ahosi || so Kassapassa sammāsambuddhassa pāvacane bhikkhusaṅghaṃ bhattena nimantetvā doṇiyā gūthassa pūrāpetvā etad avoca || || Aho bhonto yāvadatthaṃ bhuñjantu ceva harantu cāti || || Dutiyaṃ || ||
